questions.question: Where does licensing approval stall and why?
expected_points: Approval stalls at the licensor sign-off step
The Licensing Manager (Jessica) has to record the sign-off
A licensor rejection sends the package back through a rework loop

questions.question: Who records the licensor sign-off, and where is it recorded?
expected_points: Jessica, the Licensing Manager, records the sign-off
The sign-off is recorded in the Artwork Log
Recording the sign-off comes before the purchase order is created

questions.question: What happens when the licensor rejects an artwork package?
expected_points: The package is fixed and resubmitted
The resubmitted package goes back into the same approval queue
Each rejection adds weeks to the sign-off date

questions.question: How long should licensor sign-off take, and how long does it take in practice?
expected_points: The procedure expects sign-off within five business days
The Meadow Lane set has waited ten business days or more
The procedure calls for escalation when sign-off is late

questions.question: Why can't buyers raise a purchase order while licensing approval is pending?
expected_points: A purchase order cannot be cut until the sign-off is recorded
Buyers cannot commit a ship date to the vendor without the purchase order
Buyers absorb the delay when sign-off is slow

questions.question: 授权审批卡在哪个环节，为什么？
expected_points: 审批卡在授权方签署确认环节
需要授权经理杰西卡记录签署确认
授权方退回美术稿后要重新修改再提交

questions.question: 谁负责记录授权方的签署确认，记录在哪里？
expected_points: 杰西卡作为授权经理负责记录签署确认
签署确认记录在美术稿台账中
记录签署确认要在创建采购订单之前完成

questions.question: 授权方退回美术稿后会发生什么？
expected_points: 美术稿修改后重新提交
重新提交的方案回到同一个审批队列
每一次退回都会让签署确认再推迟数周

questions.question: 采购订单在什么条件下才能创建？
expected_points: 签署确认记录完成之前不能创建采购订单
没有采购订单，采购不能向供应商确认交期
签署确认变慢时延误由采购承担

questions.question: 授权方签署确认的时限要求是多久，实际又用了多久？
expected_points: 流程要求五个工作日内完成签署确认
草地小径系列实际等待了十个工作日以上
签署确认超时要按流程升级上报

questions.question: 设计部和授权部门之间的交接是怎么进行的？
expected_points: 设计部把概念方案包交给授权经理复核
复核通过后再由授权经理提交给授权方
交接中丢失的信息会拖慢签署确认

questions.question: 为什么美术稿发布经常延误？
expected_points: 授权方签署确认迟迟不下来是主要原因
退回修改的循环让发布日期一再顺延
采购在没有采购订单前无法排产

questions.question: 授权经理在审批流程中的职责是什么？
expected_points: 授权经理复核概念方案包并提交授权方
授权经理把签署确认记录到美术稿台账
授权经理在超时时负责升级上报

questions.question: 首席财务官是谁？
expected_points: 答案说明资料中没有提到首席财务官的身份
答案不猜测人名

questions.question: 明年我们计划开设多少家新店？
expected_points: 答案说明资料中没有明年的开店计划数字
答案不猜测数字
